title: Peer/receipt accepts arbitrary at field with no format validation
description: Peer/deliver validates sentAt as RFC 3339 (rejects garbage) to keep the field machine-readable. Peer/receipt accepts at on the wire with no format check (PeerReceiptArgs.at: String). The field is documented as discarded, but accepting unparsed attacker-controlled strings is inconsistent with the defensive policy applied to sentAt. If the discard decision ever changes, the field will reach storage unvalidated. Add RFC 3339 validation matching sentAt.
